page.overview:
Who is Figarland Shamrock?

Saint Figarland Shamrock is a World Noble and the commander of the Knights of God. Born in God Valley, he is the son of Saint Figarland Garling, one of the Five Elders of the World Government, as well as the older twin brother of Shanks, one of the Four Emperors.

He acts as a minor antagonist in the Elbaph Arc, spearheading the Knights' mission to annex Elbaph and leading the initial invasion.

Shamrock is a tall lean man sporting long red hair inherited from his mother, which is arranged in a small braid to the left side of his head and some facial stubble. Being his twin brother, he has a near identical physical resemblance to Shanks, with multiple characters remarking on the similarity and some even mistaking Shamrock for Shanks. Unlike his brother, he does not have a triple set of scars over his left eye and still possesses both arms.

Befitting his status as a World Noble and Knight of God, Shamrock wears a regal ensemble consisting of a high-class black and gold military tailcoat fastened with frog closures, a pair of white trousers (with black straps on the left thigh), red gloves, thigh-high brown boot (curved downward inside) with golden trim on collars, golden greaves (covers from ankle to knee) and a cravat wrapped over his neck. He keeps a golden saber over his left hip, held in place by a shoulder belt.
